patch.summary: LucroVox implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement LucroVox by mapping current marketing workflows to LucroVox objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (priority systems) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on systems of record

blocks.heading: LucroVox day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat LucroVox setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for social scheduling, funnel builder, landing pages before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves SMBs wanting combined marketing + lightweight CRM before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate priority integrations before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: SMB bundle — not enterprise marketing cloud
Do not expand seats until social scheduling is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: SMB bundle — not enterprise marketing cloud

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: SMB bundle — not enterprise marketing cloud

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: LucroVox plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: 14-day trial · Contact sales · Unlocks: social scheduling, content calendar, funnel builder · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.title: Validate marketing fit before a deep LucroVox rollout
blocks.body: If LucroVox fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft LucroVox object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on social scheduling
